question.summary: No general asymptotic formula is known for the weighted Pauli-rotation cost of preparing many copies of a pure state.
question.importance: The answer decides whether state-preparation complexity is extensive or whether a collective circuit can amortize the cost of producing repeated quantum resources.
question.unresolved: Determine the scaling of the weighted rotation cost for many copies and whether collective preparation gives a strict asymptotic saving per copy.

claims.title: The archived weighted-cost problem remains unresolved
claims.text: The cost is the infimum of the sum of absolute rotation angles. Modern Clifford-plus-T gate counts use a different resource measure.

decisions.rationale: Status assessed against the archived statement in the 2026-08-12 primary-source audit; the evidence ledger lists the results considered.

editorial.interpretation: Do not substitute gate count for the source's weighted continuous-angle cost.
